title: FORGE code, trained models and source data for RNA backbone sequence-recovery diagnostics
description: Code, trained model artifacts, processed result tables, public-input manifests and figure source data supporting the manuscript "FORGE decomposes RNA sequence recovery into memorisation, family transfer and residual prediction error". Version 0.3.0 adds the Nature Communications manuscript source, the final Figure 1 pipeline, the sequence-recovery decomposition and confidence-transport analyses, the family-disjoint in-domain evaluation, and the final AlphaFold 3 and design-audit source data.
